## Seat ruling · #32560 step 0 (2026-11-12T07:31Z)

Step 0 measured five items plus one new shape (2'). Ruling, item by item:

| # | Ruling | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 1 F4 | **Fix** → 409 `[A, platform]` (narrowing) | Same answer the protocol already gives; seat ruling Q1 on #32365 (platform + package → 409). |
| 2 F6(a) | **Fix** → 200 env item (moved answer, D3) | Env item answers first beside one package (seat ruling on #32365). |
| 2' | **Fix** → 409 `[A, B]` (narrowing) | Today a bare read picks one of two packages. That breaks the epic red line "ambiguity reported, never guessed", so closing item 2 with a written reason is **not** a valid option. |
| 3 F5 | **Fix**, served face only → 200 env item, or 409 `[A, platform]` with no env row | Same rule as 2. |
| 4 | **Fix** wording ("holders" when any non-package candidate) | Wording only. |
| 5a | **Fix** → refusal names every candidate, including environment | Red line: every refusal names every candidate. |
| 5b | **Fix** as recommended: a bare removal removes what the bare read answers (env slot only; DatabaseLoader: package-less rows only); where the read refuses, the removal refuses naming the same candidates | Consistent with #32352 ruling A (removal counts holders by package). |

Fix shape for 1/2/2': judge a bare `action` read over registry ∪ loader slots when the registry holds a package slot of the name. The extra `loaderSlotsNamed` read is accepted, scoped to bare `action` reads that hit a package slot in memory; state the cost in the PR body.

Every moved answer goes into the PR's FROM → TO table with its Clause-② arm and a pin. Items 1 and 2' carry a `(narrowing)` arm, so the dogfood battery runs. One PR (est. 700–900 lines). Build on `origin/main` after PR #32551 merges; until then work locally on the measured base. Seat-discretion ruling: one option is the only valid one under the epic red lines, so no maintainer decision is needed.
